body: ## Fixed ### Settings Startup in Other Languages Voidstrap no longer crashes while opening Settings when the sidebar is displayed in another language. ### Release Notes Opening release notes no longer crashes when a linked image or other nested Markdown link appears in the notes.

## Added ### Badge Progress in the Library The Library now shows badge progress for each game. ### Mod Generator Theme Tools The Mod Generator now has its own page, with controls to change icon opacity, choose a random color, reset to defaults, and import or export themes. ### Dedicated Mod Overlays Page Mod overlays now have their own page instead of sharing a tab with the other mod controls. ## Improved ### Breadcrumb Navigation Inspiration from Windows Settings Subpages now appear beside the page title. Select the parent title to return. This replaces separate Back buttons across game details, the Mod Generator, Latest Roblox News, extension details, Advanced Fast Flags, Mod Explorer, and mod pack details. ### Settings Layout Page titles, search, and window controls line up more consistently. Sidebar spacing and page layouts have also been refined. ### Game Shortcuts Game ID lookups wait until you finish typing, cancel older requests, and accept pasted Roblox game links. Shortcut results show a loading state while the new game is being looked up. ### Command Palette Search results now show readable setting names, group pages by sidebar section, and translate their headers, counts, and empty state. ### Voidstrap Matchmaker The Matchmaker now lives under Integrations. ### Session Dock Backdrop The in game session dock now uses a stronger backdrop blur on supported Linux compositors. Windows keeps its existing dim effect. ### Translations [![Localized](https://badges.crowdin.net/voidstrap/localized.svg)](https://crowdin.com/project/voidstrap) Voidstrap now uses Crowdin. Voidstrap should now be translated fully as well. ## Fixed ### Roblox Fullscreen Modes On Windows, borderless and exclusive fullscreen now stay active after Roblox starts. Borderless mode reapplies when Roblox restores its window during loading, and exclusive mode waits for the game window when it is not ready yet. ### FPS Unlocker The FPS unlocker now reapplies its limit after Roblox resets the frame rate cap. ### SwiftTunnel Setup and Removal SwiftTunnel installs again with its current setup program, while older releases can still use the MSI installer. Voidstrap now waits for cleanup to finish before offering a retry and handles already removed installations correctly. ### AssetWarp Removals Asset types removed with an AssetWarp option are no longer sent in Roblox's batch request as fake error entries. This prevents Roblox from failing to load affected assets. The asset cache refreshes once after this change. ### Library Badge Loading Badge loading now avoids Roblox rate limits, and missing badge icons display correctly. ### Settings and Export Stability Network or file errors in asynchronous settings actions no longer close Voidstrap. Fast Flag and validation exports also handle duplicate flag names. ## macOS (Testing) This release includes a testing version of Voidstrap for macOS. It is not a full macOS release yet, so expect bugs and missing pieces, and please report anything you run into. The virtual display starts faster and handles existing display mirroring and fullscreen changes more reliably. Intel Macs now select the requested refresh rate instead of remaining at 60 Hz. Not available on macOS yet: the account switcher, the in game Colors menu, and other Windows only options. These are hidden on macOS.

## Added ### Fleasion Warning If you have **Fleasion 2.4.0 or older** installed on Windows, Voidstrap now tells you when it starts, since those versions break Roblox game joins with **error 529**. The **Uninstall Fleasion** button removes Fleasion completely the app, its settings and cache, its certificate, hosts file entries, firewall rules and startup tasks. It also resets the Roblox asset cache Fleasion changed. ## Fixed ### AssetWarp: Join Error 529 Roblox now protects game joins on Windows, and changing them makes joins fail with **error 529**. **Make Yourself Game Creator** was the only AssetWarp option that touched joins, so it no longer works on Windows, and a notice under the option explains why. It has also been turned off once for everyone who had it on, and you can turn it back on at any time. Everything else in AssetWarp never touched joins and keeps working. Linux and macOS are not affected. ## macOS (Testing) This release includes a **testing version** of Voidstrap for macOS. It isn't a full macOS release yet, so expect bugs and missing pieces, and please report anything you run into. Not available on macOS yet: the account switcher, the in game Colors menu, and other Windows only options. These are hidden on macOS. `AppImage` users: right click the file, open **Properties**, enable **Executable as Program**, then launch it.

## Added ### NVIDIA FastFlags Warning Opening the **NVIDIA FFlags** tab now shows a warning first. These flags are for advanced users, can break Roblox and stay in your driver until you reset them. ### Session Dock Shortcut Reset The **Session dock** option on the **Mods** page now shows your current dock shortcut and has a **Reset shortcut** button that restores **Ctrl+Alt+L**. Before, clearing the shortcut inside the dock left no way to open it again. ### Linux: Nix Package Voidstrap can now be installed on NixOS and with Nix through the new Nix flake, which always builds the latest release. ## Fixed ### Crashes - Voidstrap no longer crashes when it closes and one of its windows is already gone - An error while updating your Discord status no longer closes Voidstrap ### Clock Overlay The clock overlay could turn itself on for people who never enabled it. It has been turned off once for everyone, and you can turn it back on from the **Mods** page. ### Frame Generation - Frame generation now follows the frame rate Roblox is really running at, so it stays smooth when Roblox drops below its FPS cap - Quality no longer steps down every few seconds because of a single dropped frame - It no longer gets stuck at a low output frame rate when it falls behind - The FPS cap is now set only through Roblox's own **Maximum Frame Rate** setting, so **Fix FrameCap** works again - On laptops with two GPUs, overlays and frame generation now run on the GPU Roblox renders on, so NVIDIA frame interpolation is available there - Voidstrap now cleans up trace sessions left behind by earlier crashed or closed Voidstrap processes ### RiShade - Depth effects work again. Depth of field, ambient occlusion, reflections and other depth effects failed to start for everyone - Reflections mirror the correct surface, show up as a whole floor instead of patches, and no longer flicker - Depth effects smear and flicker much less while the camera moves - **F8** now opens the RiShade panel for the whole Roblox session, even when every effect is off ### Old Roblox Clients - Old Roblox clients can be picked in **Choose Roblox version** even when they aren't installed yet. Launching installs what's needed with progress in the launcher, instead of silently starting modern Roblox - Old clients start with their launch arguments exactly as set, which fixes the 2013 Studio host failing to load - Voidstrap no longer closes itself or the old client's own web server while an old client starts ### Roblox Updates Old Roblox versions you no longer use are now removed after two weeks, so they no longer leave gigabytes of downloads behind. ### Launcher The Voidstrap and classic launcher styles stay solid when the app backdrop is set to glass. ### Shortcuts Shortcut keys are named by your keyboard layout, so a German layout shows **Ü** instead of a semicolon. ### Session Dock The dock grows with its content, and scrolls sideways past its maximum width, so the close button no longer falls off the edge. ### Other Fixes - FastFlags, file types and server replies are now checked the same way on every system language - Search results no longer sit under the scrollbar - The memory used by game and friend details is now released after they expire ### Linux - Voidstrap starts with OpenGL when Vulkan isn't available, instead of closing without a window - Overlays no longer keep retrying their placement for the whole session when it fails - Your chosen app font is used everywhere, including the footer and menus ## Improved ### Search Search now opens as a centered window like **Choose Roblox version**, with a blurred background. Typing in it is faster because the page behind it is hidden while it's open. ### RiShade Panel - Effects that are on show a dot in the effect list - The preset bar uses icon buttons, with a clear **Save** button - The **Ultra** preset is much lighter on your GPU, and sharpening is softer ### Session Dock The dock slides in and out smoothly, without flashing at its final spot first. ### Appearance Settings - The **Language** and **Bootstrapper** tabs on the **Appearance** page are now one **More** tab, which also holds sidebar layout and **App identity** - **Background and UI** options are grouped under **Color**, **Background**, **Shape** and **Text and scrolling** ### Menus The app menu, search, notifications and launch target panel use the same gray as other menus. ### Mod Generator The mod generator is simpler the preview sits at the top, colors come next, and the less common options fold into a **More options** card. ### Frame Generation Frame generation is now labeled it's release number on the **Mods** page. ## Removed ### Brightness Overlay The **Brightness** slider has been removed from the **Mods** page and the in game menu. Saturation, contrast and warmth are unchanged, and the stats overlay now always sits in the top right corner. ## macOS (Testing) This release includes a **testing version** of Voidstrap for macOS. It isn't a full macOS release yet, so expect bugs and missing pieces, and please report anything you run into. Fixed for macOS in this release: - The **virtual display** now starts before Roblox launches. Before, Roblox started on your normal screen first and stayed capped at its refresh rate - Dropdowns on Retina screens are no longer cut off and open below their box - The app icon shows in the Dock again - The homepage background no longer leaves ghost copies of text and cards behind while you scroll - Your chosen app font is used everywhere Not available on macOS yet: the account switcher, the in game Colors menu, and other Windows only options. These are hidden on macOS. `AppImage` users: right click the file, open **Properties**, enable **Executable as Program**, then launch it.

name: 1.1.3.3 (Hotfix)
body: ## Fixed ### Linux: Images and Buttons Not Loading On Linux shipped without the image library Voidstrap needs to show pictures. Pictures stayed blank, and some buttons lost their text. The image library is now always included in Linux builds, so everything loads again. ## macOS (Testing) This release includes a **testing version** of Voidstrap for macOS. It isn't a full macOS release yet, so expect bugs and missing pieces, and please report anything you run into. Not available on macOS yet: the account switcher, the in game Colors menu, and other Windows only options. These are hidden on macOS. `AppImage` users: right click the file, open **Properties**, enable **Executable as Program**, then launch it.

## Added ### Session Dock A new in game dock opens with **Ctrl+Alt+L** while you play. It slides out of the bottom of the Roblox window and keeps everything for your session in one place: Credits to @returnrqt and @GoingCrazyDude For the inspiration of this feature. *written in my own code and rebuilt from scratch* - **Games** shows the game you're in, your favorites and your **Game history** - **Servers** is a full server browser with tabs, server cards, player avatars and subplaces. Picking a server moves you through the Voidstrap Matchmaker - **Social** shows your friends and lets you chat with them without leaving the game, including recent chats - **Your profile** opens a profile panel and popout for your account - **Server details** opens the game and server information straight from the dock's game card - **Music** controls the music player - **Browser** opens a built in web browser with tabs, layouts, a smart address bar, blocking and split view, and it remembers what you had open Panels can be pinned so they stay on screen and come back the next time you open the dock. The dock loads in the background as soon as you join a game, so it opens instantly. Turn it off with **Session dock** on the **Mods** page, under **Overlays**. The dock works on Windows and Linux, Macos (testing) ### Notifications Notifications have been rebuilt from the ground up: - Choose what you get notified about: **App**, **Errors**, **Game joins**, **Recovery**, **Roblox** and **Updates** - A live preview shows exactly how a notification will look while you change its settings - **Friend notifications** tell you when a friend starts playing, joins your game or joins your server. They're off by default - **Badge notifications** tell you when you earn a badge - The close button only shows when you hover a notification, and notifications leave more smoothly ### Discord Rich Presence Your status now shows the game's owner under the game's name. ### Linux: Homepage Background Through Sober On Linux, the **Homepage background** is now drawn through Sober's own effect layer, so it looks the same as on Windows and no longer needs a separate window on top of Roblox. ## Fixed ### Hardware Acceleration Hardware acceleration no longer turns itself off. Voidstrap used to switch it off for good if a window closed too quickly or your display driver reset. Those fallbacks now only last for that one session, and hardware acceleration has been turned back on once for everyone. ### Manager - **Update** in the **Manager** no longer gets stuck or does nothing when Roblox update delivery is set to **Late** - If an install or update finishes without installing anything, the **Manager** now tells you instead of staying silent ### Overlays - Overlays now fit the visible Roblox window (#97) - Overlays stay up when a hidden Windows shell window takes focus - The crosshair and other overlays stay above the effects layer - A failing overlay no longer takes Voidstrap down with it ### Matchmaker - Your chosen datacenter is kept, and the Matchmaker never moves you to another server without telling you - Server lists are fetched more carefully, so they hit Roblox's rate limits much less often ### Offline Detection Voidstrap no longer refuses to install Roblox just because it thinks you're offline. This mostly affected people using a DNS bypass, where one Roblox server can be blocked while the internet works fine. ### Game Detection on First Launch Voidstrap now always detects the game you join, even on the very first Roblox launch on a new install. Before, it could give up because Roblox hadn't created its log folder yet, which also left Discord Rich Presence and join notifications off for that session. ### Update Notifications The **Voidstrap updated** notification only shows when Voidstrap's version actually changes, instead of after every rebuild. ### SwiftTunnel Removing **SwiftTunnel** now asks you first. Before, Windows' own uninstall prompt only appeared after SwiftTunnel's network driver and settings had already been removed, so saying no left SwiftTunnel installed without them. ### Homepage Background - Image transparency is kept instead of being filled in - A video that fails to decode no longer keeps the background checking for new frames in the background - Errors from the media picker and the preview are translated into your language ### Images - Rewrote in Rust ### Licenses - Every third party license and source notice now ships with Voidstrap, on Windows, Linux and Android ### Release Notes and Updates - Bold and italic text in release notes shows correctly - The app menu closes before **About** or the release notes open - Voidstrap on Windows only updates to a release that actually has a Windows build ### Linux - Steam Deck launches open in the right context, and Game Mode windows behave correctly - Overlays keep focus and their position, and update correctly - Clicks outside a window no longer start a resize, and an interrupted resize ends cleanly - Text reflows when you switch tabs - Install and launch buttons keep using the Linux runtime's name - The native image library also runs on older Linux distributions and on musl based ones like Alpine ### Other Fixes - Join notifications show how long the server has been running - Server details retry when Roblox drops a request, and a join notification no longer waits on a slow player count - Music keeps playing when you close the music player window - Discord Rich Presence checks its images, links and text before sending them - The tray menu no longer has a blue tint, and uses the same neutral color as other Windows menus - The minimize button in the title bar is sharp again ### Android - Removing FastFlags now actually removes them from Roblox - The helper only accepts connections from Voidstrap itself - App updates are checked against the checksum published with the release before they're installed ## Improved ### Performance - **Motion blur** is much lighter on your GPU and no longer makes Roblox stutter - The menu container no longer refreshes in the background while it's closed - The **Homepage background** fully releases its media while you're in a game, and comes back when you return to the home page - The effects layer is skipped when RiShade has no effects switched on - Smooth scrolling is sharper and skips work when nothing moved - Voidstrap waits for its window to appear before starting background startup work - **Game history** only checks whether servers are still up while the history is open - Server uptime lookups stop asking Roblox's newer join service once it says it isn't available - The Windows download is smaller: license notices are built into the app and debug files are no longer included ### Join Notifications Join notifications show up faster and in a better spot on screen. ### Linux: MangoHud Sober now works with MangoHud while Voidstrap's overlays are running. ### Images All image handling now runs through a fast native image library. Icons, mods, skyboxes, cursors, crosshairs, textures, the image tools and homepage backgrounds all use it, including animated GIF, WebP and APNG files. ### Settings Layout - The **Custom** tab on the **Integrations** page has been folded into the **Roblox** tab - **Advanced FFlags** opens from a card on the **FastFlags** page instead of its own tab, with a **Back** button to return - The **Advanced General** tab on the **Deployment** page is simpler: every section is a collapsed card, including **MTU** - The datacenter map on the **Voidstrap Matchmaker** tab now sits inside a collapsed card - Search results show each setting's real name - The **Licenses** page lists every license on its own row with a detail page - The **Choose Roblox version** picker has a cleaner layout ## Removed ### Bypass Windows Emulation Overhead The **Bypass Windows emulation overhead** option has been removed. ### Android Is Out of Testing The Android app is out of testing, so the testing notice no longer shows when it starts. ## macOS (Testing) This release includes a **testing version** of Voidstrap for macOS. It isn't a full macOS release yet, so expect bugs and missing pieces, and please report anything you run into. Not available on macOS yet: the account switcher, the in game Colors menu, and other Windows only options. These are hidden on macOS. `AppImage` users: right click the file, open **Properties**, enable **Executable as Program**, then launch it.

## Fixed ### Server Information: Player Count The player count in **Server Information** has been reworked: - It no longer gets stuck on **Rate limited**. Voidstrap waits the time Roblox asks for and shows when it will try again - Full servers show as **Full** instead of not being found, because Roblox leaves full servers out of its server list - Private and reserved servers explain why their count isn't available - Opening the window no longer lags ### Matchmaker on Home - The server picker on each game only listed servers you had already joined. It now lists every Roblox datacenter - Games started from **Home** now always use the Voidstrap Matchmaker, unless **Skip matchmaker** is on for that game - A server you picked right before pressing Play is no longer lost ### Themes - Theme presets now color the whole window instead of only a few controls - Custom themes are visible with the **Aero** backdrop - Switching themes updates every window live, with nothing left in the old colors ### AssetWarp - Assets removed by AssetWarp now get a proper blocked response, so Roblox no longer waits on them - **Remove All Textures** and **Remove All Decals** no longer remove every image as well ### Other Fixes - Preload assemblies before self-update - Buttons and badges using your accent color show black or white text depending on how bright the accent is, so text stays readable - The maximize button's tooltip says **Restore** when the window is maximized - The **Page zoom** dropdown updates live when you zoom with **Ctrl+Scroll** - Scrolling works anywhere in the **Library**, not only between cards, and **Shift+Scroll** scrolls rows sideways - Footer buttons keep their size - Hardware acceleration is turned back on once for everyone, since it could have been left off ## Added ### Home Rework (#69) - **Server for every game** picks one server region for all games, and **Use for all games** clears the per game picks - Favorite your games and Studio experiences with the star button - **See more** on **New on the Catalog** - When the Matchmaker finds the server you picked while you're already playing, Voidstrap now asks before moving you instead of moving you straight away. Turn this off with **Ask before moving servers** on the **Deployment** page Thanks to @ilgaztek47-hue for the detailed request. ### App Identity A new **App identity** section on the **Appearance** page: - **App name** renames Voidstrap everywhere it's shown: every window, title, menu, the tray and your Discord status. Links, file names and folders are never changed, so updates and Roblox links keep working - **App icon** uses any image (`.png`, `.jpg`, `.bmp`, `.gif`, `.webp`, `.tiff`, `.tga` or `.ico`) as the icon for every window, the taskbar, the tray, notifications and the launch dialog. It's converted into a sharp icon at every size automatically ### Discord Status Language **Discord status language** on the **Language** tab translates your Discord status into any language. Game names, creators, places and server locations stay exactly as they are. ### Window Corners and Corner Roundness Two new options on the **Appearance** page: - **Window corners** sets Voidstrap's windows to **Rounded**, **Slightly rounded** or **Square** - **Corner roundness** scales how round cards, buttons, boxes and menus are, from square to extra round, and updates live as you drag ### Settings Profiles - **Settings profiles** on the **Settings** page saves all your Voidstrap settings and FastFlags as named profiles you can switch between - **Global settings profiles** on the **Global** page does the same for Roblox's own settings (FPS cap, graphics quality, sensitivity, volume and more), and applies them without restarting ### Subplaces - The **Library** has a new **Subplaces** tab that lists the other places in a game, and you can launch any of them directly - The **Shortcuts** page can create a shortcut straight to a subplace Some subplaces only allow joining through an in game teleport. ### SwiftTunnel **SwiftTunnel** is now available under **Extensions** on Windows. It routes Roblox through SwiftTunnel's network while your other apps keep your normal connection. Voidstrap installs, opens and fully removes it for you. Thanks SwiftTunnel Team for allowing me to do this. ### Taskbar Tasks Right click Voidstrap on the taskbar for **Library**, which shows the icon of the last game you played, and **Notifications**. If Voidstrap is already open, it switches to that page instantly. Windows only. ### Server Location in the Roblox Window Title **Add the server info** on the **Deployment** page adds the server's region and player count to the Roblox window title. It's off by default, and it has been turned off for everyone who had it on automatically. On Linux with Wayland it needs **Run Roblox through XWayland**, and Voidstrap tells you when that's missing. ### Theme Swatches The **Global Theme** dropdown shows a color swatch for every theme, including its gradient, in both the app and the installer. **Custom** now sits right under **Default**. ### Android: Custom Backgrounds Android Voidstrap can show your own image behind every page. Go to **Settings**, **Appearance**, **Background**, and pick a photo. A **Background dim** slider keeps text easy to read. ## Improved ### Color Themes Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Cyan, Blue, Purple, Pink and Berry have been redesigned. Each one has a brighter gradient in its color, with much less black. Cards and controls are tinted glass instead of dark blocks, and text, outlines and menus match each theme. ### Custom Theme Editor The custom theme editor is now part of the **Global Theme** option and only shows when **Custom** is selected. It's simpler to use and comes with: - Theme profiles you can save, switch between and rename - A gradient editor with as many color stops as you want - Advanced colors for text, controls and cards - A theme code view for editing the theme directly Every change applies live, and it works fully on Linux. ### News Page The **News** page has been redesigned. The latest post is shown large with its image, and older posts are in a compact list under **Earlier**. Posts stay on screen while refreshing, and a failed refresh shows a warning instead of replacing your news. ### Choose Roblox Version The **Choose Roblox version** picker opens and closes much faster and more smoothly, with a clean blur behind it. ### Discord Rich Presence - Your status shows the game's name, and hovering the game icon shows which subplace you're in - While Voidstrap is open, your status shows the game, Library game, extension or mod pack you're viewing, with its icon ### Tooltips Tooltips no longer block your mouse and close as soon as you scroll ### Other Improvements - Context menus have a cleaner look - The **Library** home is cleaner - **Reset to Default Settings** on the **Global** page now sits right under the profiles ## Removed ### Theme Editor Window The separate theme editor window has been removed and replaced by the editor inside **Global Theme** (see above) ### Don't expect Linux support to be as optimal as you think as this is a more early release. Thanks to everyone helping test Voidstrap, report problems and share feedback in the community. Your reports help us find issues and improve reliability in future updates. `AppImage` users: right click the file, open **Properties**, enable **Executable as Program**, then launch it.

## Fixed ### Linux: Stuck on "Starting Roblox" With the Flatpak (#63) On some systems, NixOS in particular, the Flatpak version of Voidstrap stayed on **Starting Roblox** forever. Sober opened without a display and failed with `SDL_INIT_VIDEO failed ... wayland,x11 not available`. Voidstrap now reads your real desktop session (display, Wayland socket, session bus and session type) from the host and passes it to Sober. Sober now opens on your desktop like it does outside the Flatpak. While reproducing this, a second NixOS problem turned up and was fixed too. Programs that are links to the real file, which is how NixOS installs everything, were treated as missing. Voidstrap now follows those links when it looks for a program. If Roblox fails to start on Linux, the launch window now stays open and shows **Roblox could not start** with the error, instead of closing with no explanation. Thanks to @KSGVIO for the detailed report and logs. ### Linux: Mouse Drifting Off Screen While Turning the Camera (#66) Holding right click to turn the camera could leave the mouse on another monitor when you let go. This happened because Voidstrap started Sober through XWayland by default whenever the custom cursor or the Roblox window title and icon features were on. Sober now runs natively on Wayland by default, which keeps the mouse locked while you turn the camera. The custom cursor and window title and icon still work under Wayland if you turn on the new **Run Roblox through XWayland** option on the **Sober** page. The option says clearly that it can bring back the mouse drift. Thanks to @obaba-samich for the report. ### Roblox Priority Ignoring Your Selection The priority you choose for Roblox is now the one that's used. Before, **Optimize Roblox** and the TASX optimizer could quietly replace it with Above Normal or High. - When Roblox is in the background, **Reduce memory when out of focus** and TASX lower it to Below Normal and put your choice back when you return - Voidstrap now checks that Windows actually kept the priority and logs it when it didn't ### Matchmaker - Blocked datacenters now stay blocked. A blocked city could slip back in when its country was written differently, for example a full name instead of the country code - Teleporting inside a game no longer starts a new matchmaker search ### Linux: Overlays and Game Effects During Teleports - Frame generation now pauses while you move between servers and restarts once the new server is ready, instead of drawing stale frames - If no server join is confirmed within 60 seconds, game effects resume on their own - Leaving a game is now detected properly, so the homepage background and overlays switch back correctly ### Linux: CPU Core Limit The CPU core limit now applies to every Sober thread and reads your processor's layout correctly, so the limit covers the right cores. ### Other Fixes - Dropdowns highlight the item under your mouse properly again (This was fixed and was broken) - Menus open and close smoothly, and spacing on the Integrations page has been fixed - Turning overlays on or off on the **Mods** page now takes effect right away, and brightness changes apply live on every platform, not just Linux - Dropdowns and popups open in the right spot next to their control ## Added ### Custom Accent Color The **Appearance** page has a new **Accent color** option. Pick any color for the app's controls and background tint, or choose **Use system color** to go back to your Windows accent. ### Notifications Tab Notification settings have their own **Notifications** tab, with a switch for each kind: - Updates - Roblox and mods - Settings recovery - Errors and crashes - Game joined Turning off **App Notifications** turns them all off at once. The notification list also shows each title, message and how long ago it arrived. ### Shortcut Name and Icon Each shortcut (Roblox, Roblox Studio and Voidstrap Settings) now has a **Name and icon** section on the **Shortcuts** page and in the installer. Rename a shortcut or give it any of the Voidstrap icons or your own image (`.ico`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.bmp` or `.webp`, up to 8 MB). On Linux, shortcuts are now set up correctly and start Voidstrap reliably. ### Import Settings From Bloxstrap or Fishstrap Switching over is now one click. **Apply From** on the **Channel** page and in the installer copies your settings and FastFlags from **Bloxstrap** or **Fishstrap**, including theme, bootstrapper style, icon, channel and Discord options. ### Apply Fast Flags To A new **Apply Fast Flags to** option on the **FastFlags** page chooses whether your Fast Flags apply to the Roblox player, Roblox Studio, or both. Launches that are left out start without them, and your Fast Flags are kept. ### Fast Flag Editor Actions Right click a flag in the Fast Flag editor to **Rename** it, **Edit value**, **Copy selected as JSON** or **Delete selected**. ### Server Uptime The **Server Information** window now shows how long the server has been running. It works on Windows and on Linux through Sober, using the start time Roblox writes to its log. ### Launch Button Version Picker **Save and Launch** is now a split button. The arrow opens **Choose Roblox version**, so you can pick what it starts. You can move the arrow to the right side with **Place the version dropdown on the right**. ### AssetWarp Works With Fleasion AssetWarp can now run alongside **Fleasion**. When Fleasion is running, it forwards through AssetWarp instead of the two fighting over Roblox's traffic. Voidstrap follows Roblox launched by Fleasion and puts Fleasion's routing back when AssetWarp closes. ### Linux: NVIDIA Settings The NVIDIA page now works on Linux. FXAA, the benchmark overlay, the frame rate limiter and low latency mode apply to Sober. The benchmark overlay uses MangoHud, and Voidstrap offers to install it when needed. Settings that only exist on Windows are hidden. ### Linux: Sober Launcher A new **Launcher** option on the **Sober** page puts a command in front of Sober, for example `prime-run` on laptops with two graphics cards, `gamemoderun` or `mangohud`. If the command isn't installed, Sober starts without it. ### Uninstall Restores NVIDIA Settings Uninstalling Voidstrap now puts back the NVIDIA driver settings it changed for Roblox, asking for administrator approval when needed. If that fails, Voidstrap asks whether to uninstall anyway instead of stopping. ## Improved ### Game History Game History has been rebuilt: - Fixed Titlebar UI issue - Teleports within the same server no longer show up as separate visits - Press **Esc** to close it ### Fast Flag Search & Validation The Fast Flag search window has been rebuilt: - **Live Flag Search** loads flag names from several sources and shows exact matches first. You can export the results with all, true or false values - **Bulk Validation** checks a pasted list or a file, finds duplicates, and shows whether each flag is known and its value has the right type - **Data sources** shows which sources loaded and when ### Discord Rich Presence - Shows **Loading game** while Roblox is joining a server - Falls back to **Roblox** when a game's name can't be loaded, instead of failing - Your status clears properly when Roblox closes ### Command Palette Search in the command palette finds settings and pages more accurately, and is easier to move through with the keyboard. ### Linux - Voidstrap uses much less memory on Linux, giving memory back after you leave a game and while Roblox is running - Mods now work with Sober's Roblox files. name: 1.1.2.6 (Hotfix)
body: ## Fixed ### Windows Defender False Flagging Voidstrap Some users saw Windows Defender quarantine Voidstrap with `Trojan:Script/Wacatac.H!ml` or `Behavior:Win32/DefenseEvasion.A!ml`. Voidstrap is not malware. These are guesses from Defender's machine learning, which is more likely to flag new, unsigned programs that download and launch other programs, as every Roblox launcher does. The biggest trigger was the helper Voidstrap uses to clean up after an uninstall or after you change the install location. It worked in a way that looked suspicious to Defender, so it has been rebuilt: - It now runs as a normal, visible copy of `Voidstrap.exe` instead of a hidden copy with a random name - It no longer passes encoded data on its command line - It no longer schedules itself for deletion at restart. Leftover copies are cleaned up the next time you open Voidstrap This lowers the chance of a false detection **Heads up:** if Defender flags Voidstrap, open **Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Protection history**, select the detection and choose **Restore** --- ## Links - **Discord Server:** Join Here - **Spotify Playlist:** Check It Out Thank you to everyone who has reported bugs, tested new features, provided feedback, and supported Voidstrap through the Discord community. Your feedback directly contributes to improving the project and making future releases more reliable.

## Fixed ### Blocked by Windows Application Control (#44) Fixed Voidstrap failing to start with `System.IO.FileLoadException ... An Application Control policy has blocked this file`. Voidstrap used to unpack its own program files into your Temp folder, where Smart App Control and similar policies could block them. Those files are now loaded straight from `Voidstrap.exe`. The first-launch check for graphics problems also waits for 5 seconds of stable drawing now, so a driver reset during startup is caught too. ### "Something went wrong in FastFlagsPage" Opening FastFlag Settings could show `JsonReaderException: The input does not contain any JSON tokens` when Roblox's FastFlag allowlist post came back empty. Voidstrap now retries once and otherwise quietly uses its built-in allowlist. ### Crash When Leaving a Page Fixed a `NullReferenceException` crash that could happen when switching away from a page with animated cards. ### Other Fixes - The channel list no longer shows channels that don't exist as working with the live Roblox version - The Mod Packs disclaimer now opens right away instead of taking several seconds and sometimes showing "Not Responding" - Messages with more than one line now wrap properly and use the normal font - The **Save** and **Close** buttons no longer cut off their text in longer languages - Loading bars stop animating once they're closed, which lowers CPU use while Voidstrap sits idle - The launcher update check is skipped when you're offline, and a failed update check no longer blocks Roblox from launching ### Android: Helper Start Through Shizuku - Starting the helper through Shizuku is more reliable and no longer hangs when Shizuku refuses the connection - Voidstrap now checks that the helper is running with the right access before reporting it as started - The helper is no longer restarted through Shizuku when you're using root mode ## Added ### Android: Cable Check A new **Check the cable connection** step in the helper setup watches your USB connection live and tells you what's wrong: - USB debugging is off - The device isn't plugged in - The cable only charges and carries no data, which is why `adb devices` shows nothing - USB debugging isn't active on this connection, with the fix (switch to File transfer, or replug) - Everything is ready, with steps for the **Allow USB debugging** prompt and a link to Google's USB driver guide for Windows ### Android: Root Through the Helper If the Voidstrap helper is running with root access (for example when Shizuku runs as root), Voidstrap now uses it for mods automatically. The Root setting shows **Root access is provided by the Voidstrap helper**. ## Improved ### Music Player - Your library loads in the background, so the Music Player opens instantly even with a large library - Search results update instantly as you type - Shuffle now plays every song once before repeating any - Songs that can't be played show the reason, and when a song ends Voidstrap skips to the next one that works - Song lengths show in the library list - The equalizer uses less CPU and doesn't touch the audio at all when every band is flat - Library and equalizer changes are saved safely in the background, so quick changes aren't lost - Discord status for music shows the artist, **Paused at 1:02 of 3:45** when paused, and **On repeat** when looping - Voidstrap now remembers whether you had the Music Player's Discord status connected ### Discord Rich Presence - **In game:** the second line combines server type, location, creator and FastFlag count, for example **Public server in Frankfurt · by Creator ☑️ · 12 FFlags** - Hovering the game icon shows the game and its creator - The game button is now called **View game** - Long game names and descriptions are shortened with `...` instead of the whole status failing to update - Broken images or links in your status are skipped instead of Discord rejecting the entire status - **In the app:** your status is now named **Voidstrap Windows**, has clearer descriptions for each page, and has **Get Voidstrap** and **Join the Discord** buttons - Text and button labels in the **RPC Customizer** are fitted to Discord's limits, so custom statuses always show up ### Menus and Dropdowns - Dropdowns open about twice as fast - The selected item's accent marker animates smoothly - Menus and flyouts no longer flash a half-drawn frame when opening ## Security ### Verified Updates Only Automatic updates now only install a `Voidstrap.exe` that comes with GitHub's SHA-256 checksum, and the download is checked against it before it replaces anything. ## Removed ### Mobile Support Pages The **Mobile Setup** and **Mobile Setup Explanation** pages under Integrations have been removed. The Voidstrap Android app, added in 1.1.2.3, replaces them. --- ## What's Next? Android support keeps being refined based on your reports. As always, bug reports and feedback are extremely valuable. Crash reports include your logs automatically, so please use **Report on GitHub** whenever Voidstrap shows an error. --- ## Links - **Discord Server:** Join Here - **Spotify Playlist:** Check It Out Thank you to everyone who has reported bugs, tested new features, provided feedback, and supported Voidstrap through the Discord community. Your feedback directly contributes to improving the project and making future releases more reliable.

> **Android support, added in 1.1.2.3, can now start its helper without a computer.** Thanks to everyone who tested it and sent reports. This update also continues the Roblox installation and startup fixes from 1.1.2.3. ## Fixed ### Roblox Installation Failure (HTTP 404) A follow-up to the installation fixes in 1.1.2.3 (#39, #37). Some users still couldn't install Roblox and saw "package(s) failed during upgrade ... returned HTTP 404". Voidstrap now downloads Roblox from the same location Roblox's own installer uses, with the old location kept as a fallback. ### Crash on Launch: "Null character in path" (#41) Fixed Voidstrap crashing on every launch with `System.ArgumentException: Null character in path`. This happened when the list of installed Roblox files was damaged, usually by a power cut or sudden shutdown. Voidstrap now repairs Roblox automatically instead of crashing, and the list is saved in a way that survives power loss. ### "Failed to download or apply critical settings" Fixed Roblox sometimes closing right after launch with this error. If Roblox's settings server can't be reached yet, Voidstrap now waits a few seconds for your network before starting Roblox. ### Matchmaker Moving You Mid Game The matchmaker could pull you out of a server a minute after you had loaded in. It now searches for a better server while Roblox is still loading. If it can't move you within 10 seconds of joining, you stay in your current server. ### Saved Logins Lost After a Power Cut A power cut while saving could leave your saved Roblox accounts empty. Login files are now checked before they're copied and saved in a crash-safe way, and switching accounts still works even when the current login is damaged. ### Other Fixes - Fixed a launch failure when a Windows compatibility setting for Roblox wasn't stored as text - Fixed Voidstrap sometimes not closing after an AssetWarp session when the launch was cancelled - **Verify** on the Downloads page now reports a damaged file list as a problem instead of failing ## Added ### Android: Start the Helper Without a Computer The Voidstrap helper can now be started with **Shizuku**, no computer needed. After a restart, Voidstrap starts the helper again by itself whenever Shizuku is running. You can also: - Copy a start command for **aShell**, **LADB** or **Termux with rish** - Follow a new **Get adb on your computer** step with a link to Google's Platform Tools ### Android: Connect Without a Cable A new setup step for using adb over WiFi. It shows your device's WiFi address in ready-to-use `adb pair` and `adb connect` commands and opens Developer options straight to **Wireless debugging**. Android 10 and older get the `adb tcpip` method instead. ### Safe Launch for Startup Crashes If Roblox keeps crashing while starting, Voidstrap now: - Installs a fresh copy of Roblox - Launches it once without your mods, FastFlags, AssetWarp, matchmaker and launch integrations - Tells you whether one of those is causing the crash - If it still crashes, moves Roblox's local cache aside and tries once more ### Better Crash Reports **Report on GitHub** now opens the bug report form with your Voidstrap version, the full error details and your recent log already filled in. Before, reports opened empty. ## Security ### AssetWarp Certificate Limited to Roblox The AssetWarp certificate now only works for `roblox.com` and `rbxcdn.com` and can't be used for any other website. **Heads up:** if you use AssetWarp, Windows will ask you once to install the new AssetWarp certificate after updating. This is expected. ### Other Hardening - The Studio Rich Presence bridge now ignores requests from websites - Your Roblox login is only ever sent to `roblox.com` - Windows tools like `netsh`, `ipconfig` and `explorer` are now launched by their full system path - Links no longer open through `rundll32`, which some antivirus tools flag ## Removed ### AssetWarp Cleanup Task The scheduled task that ran Voidstrap with administrator rights at every logon has been removed, because other programs could abuse it to gain administrator access. Leftover AssetWarp entries are now cleaned up the next time Voidstrap runs with administrator access, and tasks created by older versions remove themselves. ### Cachefly Download Mirror The `roblox-setup.cachefly.net` mirror no longer works and has been removed. --- ## What's Next? Android support keeps being refined based on your reports, and Linux support is continuing toward a complete release. As always, bug reports and feedback are extremely valuable. Crash reports now include your logs automatically, so please use **Report on GitHub** whenever Voidstrap shows an error. --- ## Links - **Discord Server:** Join Here - **Spotify Playlist:** Check It Out Thank you to everyone who has reported bugs, tested new features, provided feedback, and supported Voidstrap through the Discord community. Your feedback directly contributes to improving the project and making future releases more reliable.

> **Linux support is now over 80% complete.** It is not ready for general use yet, but development is progressing rapidly and a public release is getting much closer. ## Fixed ### Roblox Installation Failure (#39) Fixed an issue that prevented Roblox from being installed correctly due to installation operations being performed on the wrong thread. ### Roblox Startup Failure (#37) Fixed an issue where Roblox could fail to start after installation. Additional fallback handling has been implemented to improve reliability during the Roblox installation and startup process. ## Added ### Sidebar Customizer Added a new **Sidebar Customizer** under Appearance. You can now: - Rename sidebar items - Customize sidebar icons - Reorganize sidebar items - Personalize the sidebar layout ### Android Support **Android support has officially been added to Voidstrap.** Android support is currently in active testing. If you encounter bugs, crashes, unexpected behavior, or compatibility issues, please report them so they can be investigated and addressed. ## Removed ### Multi Instance Launching Multi Instance Launching has been permanently removed from Voidstrap. This feature will not be reintroduced in future releases. --- ## What's Next? Linux support is continuing toward a complete release, while Android support is being actively tested and refined. As always, bug reports and feedback are extremely valuable. When reporting an issue, please provide as much information as possible, including logs when available. --- ## Links - **Discord Server:** Join Here - **Spotify Playlist:** Check It Out Thank you to everyone who has reported bugs, tested new features, provided feedback, and supported Voidstrap through the Discord community. Your feedback directly contributes to improving the project and making future releases more reliable.

name: 1.1.2.2 (Hotfix)
body: > This is primary a Hotfix update for alot of the bugs being reported! > **Linux is well over 80% complete!!** It's not ready for everyone yet, but it's getting really close. ### Fixed **Crash on launch when Roblox blocks process access** ([#26](https://github.com/KloBraticc/Voidstrap/issues/26)) Voidstrap showed `System.ComponentModel.Win32Exception: Access is denied.` and closed while Roblox was still running. Roblox's anti cheat removes handle rights from its own process, so the watcher could not open a wait handle for it. The watcher now detects this and tracks Roblox by polling instead, so the session continues normally. **Repeated "Access is denied" spam in the logs** The memory limit and TASX optimizer retried the same blocked operation every poll and logged the failure each time, forever. Both now recognise a protected Roblox process, report it once, and stop retrying for that session. The memory limit also requests only the two rights it actually needs instead of full process access, so it now works in cases where it previously failed outright. **TASX optimizer reported that it was managing a process it could not touch** The log said "Now managing Roblox process" even when every priority and throttling change was being rejected. It now states clearly when a process is protected. **Headset audio never started on 44.1 kHz devices** Capture was hardcoded to 48 kHz stereo, so on any other endpoint format it failed with "No supported capture format" and retried every 30 seconds forever. It now negotiates against the output device's real format, with fallbacks. Gain timing also assumed 48 kHz and now follows the negotiated sample rate. **Install failures gave no reason** "Roblox could not be installed: 21 package(s) failed during upgrade." discarded every underlying error. The cause is now included, with clear wording for antivirus or controlled folder access blocks, a full disk, and download timeouts. **Fixed TopBar Mod not applying** Voidstrap could not access path --- ## Links - **Discord Server:** [Join Here](https://discord.gg/5tJBqBH8ck) - **Spotify Playlist:** [Check it Out](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3EKVZWLqWbKGI8EGwP9JU5?si=7a9c0ec546c543e3) Thank to people who reported bugs and supported the project in the Discord!⭐️ Android support is incoming next update!!

Another big one. The website is gone so I pulled everything that depended on it, and I put all that time into the stuff you actually use in game instead. Multi instance, community mods, a real UI mod generator, the old topbar, Snap Tap, way faster downloads and a much smaller app. > **The Voidstrap website has been shut down for good**, it was costing me money for nothing. Accounts, quests, shop, forums and chat are gone with it, so please read the **Removed** section. > **Linux is well over 80% complete!!** It's not ready for everyone yet, but it's getting really close. --- ## New features ### Multi Instance Run as many Roblox clients as you want at the same time, each one on a different account. - Turn it on from the **Deployment** page, it's **off by default** - New **Instance Control** window from the instances button in the title bar - **Instances** tab to focus, close or close all of your running clients, and launch new ones or Studio - **Accounts** tab to launch straight into any account saved in the account switcher - Works on the current Roblox client (0.739+), the old mutex trick doesn't work anymore so I found what actually does - Every extra instance runs from its own folder link, so it takes **no extra disk space** and doesn't need admin ### Community Mods Browse and install mods from **GameBanana** and **Kliko's Mods** right inside Voidstrap. - Search, categories and load more - Install for **Voidstrap**, for **Fleasion**, or straight into **My Mods** - Mod editor so you can change a mod's rules and pick every option a GameBanana mod has - Mod packs, with your picked options saved per mod - **Every package gets checked** before it touches your PC - Has to come from a verified host over https and match the published hash - GameBanana's virus scan and content check have to pass - Anything advertising cheats, separate programs or browser extensions gets rejected - Size and file limits so a bad zip can't blow up your drive ### Mods that just keep working - **Crash guard.** If Roblox crashes while loading mods, the mod that most likely caused it gets turned off for you - **Auto fixer.** Mods survive Roblox's over the air patches, and old files that corrupt the Roblox app get skipped - **Layout repair.** When Roblox moves a file, your mods get moved with it - **AssetWarp auto enable.** If a mod needs AssetWarp to show up, Voidstrap asks to turn it on instead of it silently doing nothing - Old 2020 terrain and material texture packs are routed through AssetWarp now ### UI Mod Generator Rebuilt from the ground up. It reads Roblox's real icon list straight out of the client, about **2,500 icons across 79 sprite sheets** in under a second, so it keeps working on new Roblox versions. - Fill icons with a **solid colour**, a **gradient** (optional middle colour and angle) or an **image** - Recolours the new **Builder Icons** font too, the one normal sprite mods can't touch, gradients included - Keep coloured icons, keep icon shading, recolour buttons, bubbles and backgrounds, recolour other UI textures - Custom Roblox logo - 1x, 2x, 3x or every size ### Old Roblox TopBar - The **2014 to 2015 topbar and game menu** are back as an overlay - **Hide the modern topbar** completely (NoGuiRBX) - Hide every CoreGui image - **PS4 buttons**, swaps the Xbox button prompts for the official PS4 ones ### Snap Tap In **Integrations**. When two opposite keys are held, the last one you pressed wins instantly. Set up your own key groups (default is `A D, W S`) and pick how it behaves. ### Cursors Redid the whole cursor system. - New default cursor, **Bibata Modern Ice** - **Custom Cursor**, one image for the pointer, out of reach and text cursors - **Custom Drag Cursor** for Studio - **Custom Shiftlock** that works with every cursor style - **Cursor Sets** editor, your old sets and zips still work - Picking a preset doesn't delete your custom cursors anymore ### Texture mods In **Advanced FFlags**. - **Particles**, default, hidden, or flat squares with your own opacity - **Studs**, default or flat with a shade slider - **Terrain**, texture size and repeat hiding - **Water**, adjusted ripples, smooth, frozen frame, glitchy, or your own custom animation, with strength, speed, frame and glitch sliders and a live water preview - Your own mod files at the same paths never get overwritten ### Roblox updates and installs - **Choose Roblox version** from the title bar - **Game Update Delivery** - **Normal**, you get the update on your next launch - **Early (Opt In)**, checks Roblox's own version server so you get updates the second they go live - **Late (Opt Out)**, stays on your version for 3 days after an update so the early bugs get fixed first. A missing or broken install still updates right away - **Compress Roblox installs**, about **40% smaller** on disk while Roblox is closed. Only the one you launch gets unpacked, takes a second or two - **Launch Roblox without Voidstrap**, joining from the browser opens Roblox directly. It tells you every feature that stops working before you turn it on ### Performance - **TASX optimization**, full speed while Roblox is focused and throttled while you're tabbed out, without costing any FPS or ping - **Allocated Memory**, cap how much RAM Roblox can use - **Datacenter world map**, click a pin to pick your preferred datacenter. Drag, scroll to zoom, search a city or country, and pins are coloured by ping ### Overlays - **Motion blur** Has been added!! - GIF crosshairs from a URL, and crosshair codes you can share - One toggle to turn every overlay on or off - **RiShade window** with presets, save, import, export, reset and ReShade ini import. **F8** opens it in game - Homepage background videos decode on the GPU now, about 6% of one core at 1080p60 ### Homepage - **Latest Roblox News** from the official announcements, plus a full **Roblox News** page - **My Experiences** and **My Recent Experiences** - **Open Studio**, **Open a Template** and **Recent Files** ### App - **Release Notes** window, you can read these right inside Voidstrap - **Notifications** in the title bar for crashes, errors and important updates - New title bar menu with About, Check for Updates, Restart, Release Notes, Support, and quick links to logs and the app folder - Search all of Voidstrap - **More** group in the sidebar for Global, Shortcuts and News - Download card in the bottom right for every download, you can cancel from there - Tells you when Voidstrap is offline - Language list shows flags and how complete each translation is - New **Appearance** and **Mods** pages in the installer - Redid the **Shortcuts** page, private server share links work now - Bundled **Inter** font ### Linux (well over 80% complete) Linux isn't fully ready yet, but here's what's already done. - **Sober** built in, with sharpness and auto fullscreen - **Vinegar** for Studio, renderer, GPU, GameMode, virtual desktop, launcher, forced version, channel, Wine root, Discord presence and your FastFlags - Pick the renderer backend Voidstrap draws with - Tray icon, app menu entry, Roblox link handling, native file dialogs and a bunch of window fixes - **AppImage, Flatpak, RPM and Arch** packages are set up I'll let everyone know in the Discord when it's ready. --- ## Improved ### Downloads - Responses are capped at 8 MB now. - **Fixed requests that could hang forever.** Every call has a 20 second timeout now. - **Hardened launch arguments.** Deeplinks are strictly validated (scheme allowlist, length limit, control characters rejected) and arguments are passed as a proper list instead of being glued into a command string. - **Fixed leaked HTTP responses.** Responses weren't being disposed, which held connections open. ### Crashes and data loss - **Fixed background crashes going completely unreported.** Only errors on the UI thread were caught before, so anything that failed on a background thread vanished silently. Crashes in tasks and on any thread are now caught and logged. - **Fixed settings getting wiped.** Saves are atomic now with automatic backup recovery, so a crash or power loss mid save can't destroy your config. - **Fixed settings being overwritten on OneDrive.** If your Voidstrap folder is cloud synced and the file isn't downloaded locally, Voidstrap now tells you instead of silently replacing your settings with defaults. - **Fixed crashes from using disposed objects.** Went from 2 guards against this to 35. - **Fixed corrupt config killing startup.** Bad JSON now falls back to the last good backup instead of failing. - **Fixed downloads dying on a bad connection.** They retry and resume now. - **Fixed malformed images crashing the app** during loading. ### Memory leaks - **Fixed a large number of event handler leaks.** Handlers were subscribed and never removed, so windows and pages stayed alive forever. Explicit comparisons went from 118 to 767. - **Faster downloads** with multiple packages at once and segmented transfers. - **Memory manager** that releases memory when you tab out and restores it during gameplay. - **Parallel processing** added where work was needlessly sequential. ### Other - **Swapped the whole graphics stack.** SharpDX has been dead for years so I moved everything (D3D11, DXGI, shader compiling, DirectComposition) over to Vortice which is actually maintained. - **Download is a lot smaller now.** The app isn't self contained anymore so the installer and updates are way lighter. - **Updated to current .NET 10** instead of the old Windows 8 target, and pinned the SDK so builds are consistent. - **Fixed mismatched version numbers.** The version lives in one place now instead of being duplicated in several files. - **Removed old compatibility packages** that were shadowing the real runtime versions. - **Updated WebView2** from 1.0.3800.47 to 1.0.4078.44. - **Fixed the bootstrapper defaulting wrong on Windows 10.** It assumed Windows 11 before. It also scales now. - **Cleaned up the repo.** Deleted leftover junk files, fixed 5 filenames that had trailing spaces, and fixed a setting that was named wrong (`exitondissy` to `ExitOnDissy`). --- ## Removed Some things are gone in this update. - **SwiftTunnel VPN** and the whole login for it. It kept breaking and I'm not maintaining it. - **AI Chat** page - **Discord chat panel** - **GPU overclocking** and NVIDIA profile stuff. Too risky and too dependent on your specific hardware. - **Motion blur** including desktop capture blur - **Plugins page** and **Hub page** - **Anime RPC** and the anime window - **DX12 toggle**, play history, client settings saver - Settings that went with them: `AniWatch`, `FPSCounter`, `ForceRobloxLanguage`, `Fullbright`, `IngameChatDiscord`, `LockDefault`, `MotionBlurOverlay` Spotify and the YouTube downloader are gone too. --- ## Linux and macOS I've been rebuilding Voidstrap so it can run on Linux and macOS, and most of the groundwork is done. The app got split into separate platform projects and the UI layer got ported. Packaging scripts for AppImage, deb, rpm, Arch and macOS dmg are written. **It's not ready yet though**, so this release is Windows only. I'm not shipping it until it actually works properly. Linux is also getting Sober integration so Voidstrap can install and launch Roblox through Sober directly. I'll let everyone know in Discord when it's ready. ---

This is by far the biggest update I have ever done. I basically rebuilt the whole app and added a ton of new stuff on top. > **Windows only for now.** Linux and macOS are being worked on but they're not ready yet, more on that at the bottom. > This update is huge so please read the **Removed** --- ## Fixes This is a minor Continuation of last version but with some fixes included - Fixed **Voidstrap chat** not showing when not signed in. - Added to Voidstrap chat Herm Chat for all Bootstrap global chat (for later will enable soon) - Added **If Not Working** InfoBar to homepage to improve my sanity on issues.. lol - Roblox installation issue where RobloxPlayerBeta.exe can't find its required DLL, which in newer versions gets extracted from the RobloxApp.zip package. - Fixed Auto updating (you must download this release) ## Voidstrap accounts You can sign into Voidstrap now, and it actually does something. - Sign in with multiple accounts and switch between them whenever - **Your FastFlag profiles save to your account**, so you can pull them down on any PC instead of copying JSON around - Friends list and notifications inside the app - Profile editor with gradients and borders - Your play history syncs ### Forums Built in forums. Post, reply, like and dislike, images, mentions, avatars, badges and emoji. All tied to your account. ### Quests, Shop and Black Market There's a level system now. Complete quests, earn XP, level up, and get notified when you finish one. - **Shop** to spend what you earn - **Black Market** for boosts, double, triple and quadruple XP, playtime boosts, or the all in one --- ## New features ### AssetWarp A local proxy that sits between Roblox and its servers so you can actually see and mess with game assets. - Capture and browse assets with a preview - Strip textures, decals, images, meshes or animations - Preload assets ahead of time, even across games, with your own cache size - Avatar preloading - Spoof your username or presence (only you see it) - Route through HTTP CONNECT or SOCKS5 if you want > **Read this before turning it on.** AssetWarp has to look at HTTPS traffic to work, so it makes a certificate that is **unique to your PC** and trusts it for your account only. The key never leaves your machine and Windows encrypts it. Uninstalling Voidstrap removes it. Voidstrap still checks every real server certificate properly. It's **off by default** and asks you first. ### RiShade Shaders built into Voidstrap, kind of like ReShade. Has depth buffer access, anti smear, and you can import ReShade presets you already have. ### Frame Generation NVIDIA frame gen. Set a target FPS, uncap it, split screen compare, and there's an overlay so you can see what it's doing. ### Anti Aliasing Post process AA applied over the Roblox window, pick your method. ### Game Chat Chat overlay so you don't have to leave fullscreen. Emotes, filtering, name colors, profile viewer, and you can move and resize the window. ### Voidstrap Matchmaker Finds you the closest server instead of letting Roblox pick a random one. - Uses real datacenter locations, not guessing - Pick your preferred datacenters or block ones you don't want, even per game - Prefer empty servers - Learns from the servers you actually end up playing on ### Overlays Redid the whole overlay system. HUD, crosshair (shape, size, gap, thickness, color, outline, opacity), FPS cap, present tracer, window tracker, diagnostics. ### Classic clients Launch old Roblox clients straight from Voidstrap, 2007 through 2010 and up. They download with integrity checking so you know you got the real thing. There's also a full local server for them now, so classic clients actually work: asset delivery, thumbnails, avatars, body colors, badges, friends, marketplace and player tracking, plus an auth server with a UDP proxy so your friends can join you. ### Bootstrapper themes Install themes from the website with one click, and they auto update when the creator changes them. You can build your own in the editor and publish it, and Voidstrap will show you what changed between your local copy and the published one. ### Roblox Studio Rich presence for Studio with no plugin needed. Shows your place, what script you're in, and if you're in Team Create or playtesting. Rojo support too. ### Auto translate, 80 new languages Voidstrap used to ship in **30 languages** that were translated by hand. Now it can translate itself into **109**, so that's **80 languages added** that were never supported before. - Translates the **entire** app, not just the parts that were translated by hand. Anything hardcoded gets translated too - Turning it off puts every original string back properly, no restart and no leftovers - Translations are cached to disk so it only fetches each string once, and it stays fast after the first run - URLs and links are never translated so nothing breaks The 30 hand translated languages are still there and still the default if you speak one of them. ### Accessibility and display - Color blindness simulation and correction with type and severity - Color temperature, contrast, saturation - Custom app font, font scaling, UI zoom - Fake borderless and fake exclusive fullscreen - Window backdrops (Mica, Acrylic, etc) ### Performance - Memory manager that backs off when you tab out and gives it back during gameplay - Render acceleration and a dynamic render system - Roblox process optimizer and efficiency mode - Emulation overhead bypass ### Other stuff - **Faster downloads**, multiple packages at once and split into segments, with an actual accurate ETA - **Telemetry blocking** for Roblox - **Audio**: duck Roblox audio when you tab out, headset loudness, custom death sound volume - **Homepage background media** with overlay, gradient and blur - New **Library** (with pinning), **Downloads**, **Game**, **Friends**, **Notifications** and **News** pages - Custom fonts including Google Fonts, and installing your own - Skybox converter, sharpening, screen color effects, accent color following Windows - Launch at startup, minimize to tray - Show server info in the window title, cycle title with game name - 24 hour clock and timezone picker --- ## Fixed ### Security - **Fixed a path traversal hole in archive extraction.** Mods, themes and updates used to extract with zero validation, so a crafted zip could write files outside the folder it was meant to go in. Every entry is now checked to make sure it stays inside the target folder. - **Fixed unbounded HTTP responses.** There was no size limit, so a bad or hostile server could make Voidstrap eat memory until it died. Responses are capped at 8 MB now. - **Fixed requests that could hang forever.** Every call has a 20 second timeout now. - **Hardened launch arguments.** Deeplinks are strictly validated (scheme allowlist, length limit, control characters rejected) and arguments are passed as a proper list instead of being glued into a command string. - **Fixed leaked HTTP responses.** Responses weren't being disposed, which held connections open. ### Crashes and data loss - **Fixed background crashes going completely unreported.** Only errors on the UI thread were caught before, so anything that failed on a background thread vanished silently. Crashes in tasks and on any thread are now caught and logged. - **Fixed settings getting wiped.** Saves are atomic now with automatic backup recovery, so a crash or power loss mid save can't destroy your config. - **Fixed settings being overwritten on OneDrive.** If your Voidstrap folder is cloud synced and the file isn't downloaded locally, Voidstrap now tells you instead of silently replacing your settings with defaults. - **Fixed crashes from using disposed objects.** Went from 2 guards against this to 35. - **Fixed corrupt config killing startup.** Bad JSON now falls back to the last good backup instead of failing. - **Fixed downloads dying on a bad connection.** They retry and resume now. - **Fixed malformed images crashing the app** during loading. ### Memory leaks - **Fixed a large number of event handler leaks.** Handlers were subscribed and never removed, so windows and pages stayed alive forever. Unsubscribes went from 23 to 511. - **Fixed objects never being cleaned up.** Proper disposal went from 22 types to 349, and cleanup calls from 64 to 711. - **Fixed timers running after their window closed.** - **Fixed socket exhaustion** from creating new HTTP clients per request instead of reusing them. ### Freezes and threading - **Fixed UI deadlocks.** Async calls that could deadlock the interface were corrected across the app, from 62 to 990 properly configured awaits. - **Fixed operations that couldn't be cancelled.** Cancellation support went from 95 to over 1000 places, so closing a window or cancelling a download actually stops the work instead of leaving it running. - **Fixed race conditions** on values read and written from multiple threads at once, using proper atomic operations and volatile fields where there were none before. - **Fixed concurrent access corrupting shared state**, with proper locking added where it was missing. - **Removed blocking sleeps** that froze the interface. ### Performance - **Cut allocations heavily** by using spans and pooled buffers instead of copying data around, which means less stuttering from garbage collection. - **Fixed slow and locale dependent string comparisons.** These could also behave differently depending on your Windows language. Explicit comparisons went from 118 to 767. - **Faster downloads** with multiple packages at once and segmented transfers. - **Memory manager** that releases memory when you tab out and restores it during gameplay. - **Parallel processing** added where work was needlessly sequential. ### Other - **Swapped the whole graphics stack.** SharpDX has been dead for years so I moved everything (D3D11, DXGI, shader compiling, DirectComposition) over to Vortice which is actually maintained. - **Download is a lot smaller now.** The app isn't self contained anymore so the installer and updates are way lighter. - **Updated to current .NET 10** instead of the old Windows 8 target, and pinned the SDK so builds are consistent. - **Fixed mismatched version numbers.** The version lives in one place now instead of being duplicated in several files. - **Removed old compatibility packages** that were shadowing the real runtime versions. - **Updated WebView2** from 1.0.3800.47 to 1.0.4078.44. - **Fixed the bootstrapper defaulting wrong on Windows 10.** It assumed Windows 11 before. It also scales now. - **Cleaned up the repo.** Deleted leftover junk files, fixed 5 filenames that had trailing spaces, and fixed a setting that was named wrong (`exitondissy` to `ExitOnDissy`). --- ## Removed Some things are gone in this update. - **SwiftTunnel VPN** and the whole login for it. It kept breaking and I'm not maintaining it. - **AI Chat** page - **Discord chat panel** - **GPU overclocking** and NVIDIA profile stuff. Too risky and too dependent on your specific hardware. - **Motion blur** including desktop capture blur - **Plugins page** and **Hub page** - **Anime RPC** and the anime window - **DX12 toggle**, play history, client settings saver - Settings that went with them: `AniWatch`, `FPSCounter`, `ForceRobloxLanguage`, `Fullbright`, `IngameChatDiscord`, `LockDefault`, `MotionBlurOverlay` Spotify and the YouTube downloader are gone too. --- ## Linux and macOS I've been rebuilding Voidstrap so it can run on Linux and macOS, and most of the groundwork is done. The app got split into separate platform projects and the UI layer got ported. Packaging scripts for AppImage, deb, rpm, Arch and macOS dmg are written. **It's not ready yet though**, so this release is Windows only. I'm not shipping it until it actually works properly. Linux is also getting Sober integration so Voidstrap can install and launch Roblox through Sober directly. I'll let everyone know in Discord when it's ready. ---

Every entry is now checked to make sure it stays inside the target folder. - **Fixed unbounded HTTP responses.** There was no size limit, so a bad or hostile server could make Voidstrap eat memory until it died. Responses are capped at 8 MB now. - **Fixed requests that could hang forever.** Every call has a 20 second timeout now. - **Hardened launch arguments.** Deeplinks are strictly validated (scheme allowlist, length limit, control characters rejected) and arguments are passed as a proper list instead of being glued into a command string. - **Fixed leaked HTTP responses.** Responses weren't being disposed, which held connections open. ### Crashes and data loss - **Fixed background crashes going completely unreported.** Only errors on the UI thread were caught before, so anything that failed on a background thread vanished silently. Crashes in tasks and on any thread are now caught and logged. - **Fixed settings getting wiped.** Saves are atomic now with automatic backup recovery, so a crash or power loss mid save can't destroy your config. - **Fixed settings being overwritten on OneDrive.** If your Voidstrap folder is cloud synced and the file isn't downloaded locally, Voidstrap now tells you instead of silently replacing your settings with defaults. - **Fixed crashes from using disposed objects.** Went from 2 guards against this to 35. - **Fixed corrupt config killing startup.** Bad JSON now falls back to the last good backup instead of failing. - **Fixed downloads dying on a bad connection.** They retry and resume now. - **Fixed malformed images crashing the app** during loading. ### Memory leaks - **Fixed a large number of event handler leaks.** Handlers were subscribed and never removed, so windows and pages stayed alive forever. Unsubscribes went from 23 to 511. - **Fixed objects never being cleaned up.** Proper disposal went from 22 types to 349, and cleanup calls from 64 to 711. - **Fixed timers running after their window closed.** - **Fixed socket exhaustion** from creating new HTTP clients per request instead of reusing them. ### Freezes and threading - **Fixed UI deadlocks.** Async calls that could deadlock the interface were corrected across the app, from 62 to 990 properly configured awaits. - **Fixed operations that couldn't be cancelled.** Cancellation support went from 95 to over 1000 places, so closing a window or cancelling a download actually stops the work instead of leaving it running. - **Fixed race conditions** on values read and written from multiple threads at once, using proper atomic operations and volatile fields where there were none before. - **Fixed concurrent access corrupting shared state**, with proper locking added where it was missing. - **Removed blocking sleeps** that froze the interface. ### Performance - **Cut allocations heavily** by using spans and pooled buffers instead of copying data around, which means less stuttering from garbage collection. - **Fixed slow and locale dependent string comparisons.** These could also behave differently depending on your Windows language. Explicit comparisons went from 118 to 767. - **Faster downloads** with multiple packages at once and segmented transfers. - **Memory manager** that releases memory when you tab out and restores it during gameplay. - **Parallel processing** added where work was needlessly sequential. ### Other - **Swapped the whole graphics stack.** SharpDX has been dead for years so I moved everything (D3D11, DXGI, shader compiling, DirectComposition) over to Vortice which is actually maintained. - **Download is a lot smaller now.** The app isn't self contained anymore so the installer and updates are way lighter. - **Updated to current .NET 10** instead of the old Windows 8 target, and pinned the SDK so builds are consistent. - **Fixed mismatched version numbers.** The version lives in one place now instead of being duplicated in several files. - **Removed old compatibility packages** that were shadowing the real runtime versions. - **Updated WebView2** from 1.0.3800.47 to 1.0.4078.44. - **Fixed the bootstrapper defaulting wrong on Windows 10.** It assumed Windows 11 before. It also scales now. - **Cleaned up the repo.** Deleted leftover junk files, fixed 5 filenames that had trailing spaces, and fixed a setting that was named wrong (`exitondissy` to `ExitOnDissy`). --- ## Removed Some things are gone in this update. - **SwiftTunnel VPN** and the whole login for it. It kept breaking and I'm not maintaining it. - **AI Chat** page - **Discord chat panel** - **GPU overclocking** and NVIDIA profile stuff. Too risky and too dependent on your specific hardware. - **Motion blur** including desktop capture blur - **Plugins page** and **Hub page** - **Anime RPC** and the anime window - **DX12 toggle**, play history, client settings saver - Settings that went with them: `AniWatch`, `FPSCounter`, `ForceRobloxLanguage`, `Fullbright`, `IngameChatDiscord`, `LockDefault`, `MotionBlurOverlay` Spotify and the YouTube downloader are gone too. --- ## Linux and macOS I've been rebuilding Voidstrap so it can run on Linux and macOS, and most of the groundwork is done. The app got split into separate platform projects and the UI layer got ported. Packaging scripts for AppImage, deb, rpm, Arch and macOS dmg are written. **It's not ready yet though**, so this release is Windows only. I'm not shipping it until it actually works properly. Linux is also getting Sober integration so Voidstrap can install and launch Roblox through Sober directly. I'll let everyone know in Discord when it's ready. ---
